author: Ankit
problem: Each meeting is a (start, end) pair of hours, where end is when it finishes. Return how many pairs of meetings would need the same room at the same moment.
bug_description: Uses <= in the overlap test, so a meeting that ends exactly when another starts is counted as a clash.

comments.accurate: Counts pairs of meetings that would need the room at the same time
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts pairs of meetings whose times touch or overlap
comments.wrong_location: Overlap test verified; check that each pair of meetings is counted only once
